ana.peopleops: Quick help please — employee had noninvasive prenatal testing (NIPT) while traveling in Portugal on 05/02. Lab billed under "LIS Global" TIN and insurer flagged it out-of-network. Claim GN-307 denied for provider mismatch. Employee has Redwood Core PPO and prior auth PA-7765 for prenatal testing. Need: 1) temp proof-of-coverage so local clinic will proceed with a follow-up ultrasound tomorrow, 2) steps to get claim reprocessed as in-network.

lee.benefits: Two things. Proof PDF to show clinic so they don't cancel, and a resubmission script for the lab. If PA-7765 is on file and dates match, insurer should reconsider once lab resubmits with the contracted billing entity.

lab-liaison: Labs abroad often bill under a parent diagnostic corp TIN that doesn't match the insurer's provider file. They need to resubmit with the contracting entity NPI/TIN used for network agreements, and include the prior auth number in the claim remarks.

sophia.hr: Can benefits draft the exact claim remark text we should ask the lab to use? Employee flies back Sunday so time is tight. Also want the temp proof-of-coverage wording to email the clinic.

lee.benefits: Suggested claim note: "Reprocess claim GN-307: Prior Authorization PA-7765 applies. Correct billing provider NPI/TIN to contracted provider as per insurer provider file. Denial attributed to provider credential mismatch. Attach PA documentation, itemized invoice, and lab requisition." Have them populate claim box/remarks with PA-7765 and mark as 'reconsideration'.

benefits-bot: Generating temporary proof-of-coverage (informational only)... Draft: "Redwood Inference \u2014 Temporary Proof of Coverage (not a guarantee of payment). Member: [NAME]. Plan: Redwood Core PPO. Coverage dates: 01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026. Prior Authorization: PA-7765 (NIPT). For claims inquiries call insurer provider relations 1-800-555-0199 or submit provider portal case at provider.insurer.example.com. Please confirm billing provider NPI/TIN matches insurer provider file before submitting claims."

ana.peopleops: Small edit: add a line for scheduling staff: "Present this letter and PA-7765 at check-in to confirm authorization details."

lee.benefits: Good. Also add instruction to the employee: upload the EOB and the lab invoice to the benefits portal and DM us a confirmation so we can open an insurer escalation once lab confirms resubmission. We'll attach PA-7765 and request reprocessing.

lab-liaison: If insurer declines reprocessing, escalate to provider relations with documentation and the PA. For foreign labs, adding the contracted US billing entity NPI often fixes it. If lab can't reissue, consider asking them for an itemized invoice to file for in-network reimbursement request via provider relations.

sophia.hr: Thanks. I'll send the temp PDF and script to the employee and cc the clinic. @lee.benefits please open escalation after resubmission. Employee is anxious so will update here when they confirm. :pray:
